statement:
(K V : Type) [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [LinearAlgebraGame.VectorSpace K V] [DecidableEq V] (w : V) (sw sx : Finset V)
  (fx fw fw' : V → K) (hfw : w = ∑ v ∈ sw, fw v • v) (hfw' : fw' = fun v => if v ∈ sw then fx w * fw v else 0) :
  fx w • w = ∑ v ∈ sw ∪ sx \ {w}, fw' v • v
name: LinearAlgebraGame.fw_sum_equality
content:
`fw_sum_equality` is a helper proof that, given `hfw : w = sw.sum (fun v => fw v • v)`
and `hfw' : fw' = fun v => ite (v ∈ sw) (fx w * fw v) 0`, the equality
`fx w • w = (sw ∪ (sx \ {w})).sum (fun v => fw' v • v)` holds. The syntax is
`fw_sum_equality K V w sw sx fx fw fw' hfw hfw'`.
